title: Same variable, opposite directions
summary: Rainfall is rising in the Western Sahel while Central Chile is drying: one variable, two regions, two directions.

analysis.verdict: Precipitation increased by about 0.028 mm/day per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p = 0.0035): it is very unlikely to be just chance.
Precipitation decreased by about 0.11 mm/day per decade (1981–2025). This trend is statistically significant (p < 0.001): it is very unlikely to be just chance.
